error[ZBX-E0011]: -e names a variable that is not set
  cause  -e UNSET_VARIABLE copies UNSET_VARIABLE from zbx's environment, and it
         is not set there (or is longer than 4096 bytes)
  fix    give it a value:                  zbx run -e NAME=VALUE ...
         or set it for this one command:   NAME=VALUE zbx run -e NAME ...
  more   zbx explain E0011 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0011.html
